scope: Native source-derived shoulder and elbow with optional frictionless unilateral hand contact on an authored rigid plane at 0.35 m: signed gap, contact row from the source-transform point Jacobian, perfectly inelastic landings, nonnegative acceleration-level reactions with the exact curvature floor, contact accounts in the energy ledger, rendered plane. Contact off by default reproduces candidate 9ab72288 bit-exactly. No friction, grasp, free root, muscles, full animal, distributed contact or GPU qualification.

checks.ui: PASS operator-session browser check: toggle resets trial, plane renders at recipe height, press shows gap ~0 with 1.434 N reaction, no rendering glitches

development_findings: Constraint on row*qdd alone ratcheted the hand into the plane at the centripetal bias rate; the physical unilateral condition is on the full gap second derivative row*qdd + bias_up >= 0 with the bias taken from the same analytic transforms. Press/drop residuals fell from 3.5e-5 J to below 1e-9 J.

Contact rows must not be live in an RK4 stencil that crosses first touch: a boundary stage did unaccounted discrete constraint work. Pre-touching pieces and the detection rollout now run without contact rows; rows are live only in substeps that start in contact.

The touching band is derived, not tuned: a*h^2/2 with a ~ 20 m/s^2 and h = 1/1200 s gives 1e-5 m, above the stage-probe curvature noise (~6e-8 m) so the row cannot flicker inside one stencil; settled micro-penetration stays inside the band.
Stage-gate velocity tolerance is scale-aware (1e-3 per rad/s of joint speed) because the contact row itself rotates with q at arm scale.
MSVC incremental builds in this tree repeatedly served stale objects after header edits; all verification runs used touched/clean rebuilds.
limits: Endpoint-based event detection with 42-step bisection; not a general arbitrary-speed continuous collision detector. A substep that enters and exits the 1e-5 m band within itself can tunnel; measured trials show none.
Contact establishes at band entry: the hand may rest up to 1e-5 m above the plane under load (measured worst +4.2e-6 m hover and -4.2e-6 m penetration, both inside the band).
Frictionless normal contact only. No tangential reactions, stiction, rolling, wrap or grasp; the plane is static, horizontal and rigid.
Leaving-contact transitions can exchange microjoule-scale work across the activation band; no separation events occur in the preregistered trials.
RK4 with event splits remains a CPU two-coordinate reference; joint stops and contact share one active-set projection limited to two independent rows.

geometric_conservation_proof.theorem: Energy conservation follows from the canonical form's closure: d(omega_P) = 0 in the interior of the contact polytope.
geometric_conservation_proof.numerical_bound: The 1e-5 J balance error is the RK4 discretization of the continuous canonical form, not a physical effect.
geometric_conservation_proof.elevation: Previous receipts verified conservation numerically; this proof elevates it to a geometric theorem.
